spec.name: zeb/potoru
spec.description: Potoru 2D animation for RWE templates: a .poto player (canvas, slides, interactive stories, host bridge) and an in-browser compiler from Potoru source folders. Offline; player and compiler load on demand.

0.1.note: Potoru web player 0.1.0 + format v4 compiler + authoring API (Potoru sources, Apache-2.0) via esbuild 0.28.1 with code splitting; lazy chunks, wasm engines, score-worker.js, potoru-authoring-sandbox.js and fonts/ sit next to the entry (new URL(..., import.meta.url)). Build: POTORU_SRC=<potoru>/designer/e3 node build/build.mjs (= esbuild --bundle --splitting --format=esm --minify --target=es2022 --outdir=0.1/runtime --entry-names=[name] --chunk-names=[name]-[hash] --out-extension:.js=.mjs entry.mjs, plus a worker build and an IIFE sandbox build; see NOTES.md). Every file: FILES-SHA256.txt.
